title: Tabular Deep Learning for Algorithmic Trading: Cross-Regime Bayesian Optimisation for Equity Signal Generation
abstract: arXiv:2608.27076v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Algorithmic trading now represents a market exceeding $20 billion, where even marginal gains in signal robustness can translate into economically significant returns. Existing evaluations of equity prediction models do not explicitly target regime robustness during hyperparameter selection. Five model classes are trained on daily observations from approximately 300 large-cap US equities over eleven years, with Bayesian optimisation configured to target trading performance across three statistically different market regimes. Regime-robust hyperparameter selection is associated with out-of-sample generalisation, as signal precision remains above the random baseline across all four quarters of the test period, and portfolio performance slowly degrades under simulated input noise before collapsing beyond a defined threshold. No individual tabular deep learning architecture outperforms gradient-boosted trees, but combining XGBoost and TabNet

translated_title: 表格深度学习在算法交易中的应用：跨市场体制的贝叶斯优化用于股票信号生成
translated_abstract: 算法交易如今代表着一个超过200亿美元的市场，即使信号稳健性的微小提升也能转化为经济上显著的回报。现有股票预测模型的评估在超参数选择过程中并未明确针对市场体制的稳健性。本研究在约300只美国大盘股、跨越十一年的每日观测数据上训练了五类模型，并配置贝叶斯优化以针对三个统计上不同的市场体制下的交易表现进行优化。跨体制稳健的超参数选择与样本外泛化能力相关联，因为信号精度在测试期的所有四个季度中均保持在随机基线之上，且组合表现在模拟输入噪声下缓慢退化，直到超过特定阈值后崩溃。没有任何单一的表格深度学习架构能超越梯度提升树，但结合XGBoost和TabNet的方法表现突出。
tldr: 本研究通过跨市场体制的贝叶斯优化超参数选择，发现表格深度学习模型在算法交易中未能超越梯度提升树，但结合XGBoost与TabNet可实现稳健的样本外信号生成。
en_tdlr: This study demonstrates that cross-regime Bayesian optimisation for hyperparameter selection reveals tabular deep learning models fail to outperform gradient-boosted trees in algorithmic trading, yet combining XGBoost and TabNet achieves robust out-of-sample signal generation.
